title: Structured JSON output is truncated at the tail
description: Long structured generations sometimes end with a dangling comma or partial object, and downstream parsing fails during final recovery.
expected_behavior: The workflow should recover a valid JSON prefix or retry cleanly.
log_excerpt: JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes near char 3187
stacktrace_excerpt:
File "app/engine.py", line 83, in generate_json
  parsed = safe_json_loads(raw_text)
File "app/utils.py", line 141, in safe_json_loads
  raise JSONDecodeError(...)

repository_artifacts.snippet: generate_json calls safe_json_loads after collecting the raw text payload.
safe_json_loads attempts conservative recovery for partial JSON tails and strips dangling commas before parsing.
reporting utilities format workflow summaries for dashboards and alerting sinks.
runtime configuration toggles affect generation budgets but do not parse JSON payloads.
